implementation_boundary: App-owned SwiftUI and RealityKit presentation only. These values carry no anatomical, diagnostic, treatment, comfort, or performance meaning.

native_material_policy.preferred: SwiftUI glassBackgroundEffect or the deployment target's reviewed native glass equivalent
native_material_policy.reduce_transparency_fallback: Replace glass with an opaque high-contrast system background while preserving hierarchy and controls.

accent_focus.meaning: Selected teaching focus; never the only pathology cue

success_state.meaning: Completed interface action only; never treatment success

contrast_targets.policy: Design targets only. Verify the assembled view in light and dark environments, Increase Contrast, Reduce Transparency, and on physical hardware.

depth_and_attachment_starting_points.policy: Starting points, not comfort guarantees. Clamp placement, avoid face-locked motion, and replace these values after physical-device accessibility and human-factors QA.

motion.policy: Respect system Reduce Motion and the explicit viewer motion preference. No motion may imply physiology or urgency.

accessibility_requirements: Never encode state by color alone.
Use Dynamic Type-compatible native styles and allow body copy to expand.
Supply VoiceOver labels, values, hints, and an ordered reading path.
Keep warnings available in text when a visual tier hides optional detail.
Provide Pause, Show Less, Show More, Exit or Return, and Restore Original where adaptation is enabled.
Verify seated and reclined reach, contrast, focus order, and label occlusion on physical Apple Vision Pro hardware.
